name: Grievance Registered
subject: CivicOne: Grievance {case_number} Registered
body_template: Dear {citizen_name} your grievance regarding {category} in {ward} has been registered under {case_number}. SLA Target: {sla_hours} hours.

name: Grievance Registered Hindi

body_template: प्रिय {citizen_name} {ward} में {category} के संबंध में आपकी शिकायत {case_number} दर्ज कर ली गई है। समाधान लक्ष्य: {sla_hours} घंटे।

name: Officer Assigned

name: Resolution Evidence Submitted Hindi
subject: CivicOne: शिकायत {case_number} का समाधान - पुष्टि आवश्यक

name: SLA 75% Warning
